name: @taxat/workspace-root
description: Taxat monorepo bootstrap root for control-plane, operator web, client portal, provisioning workbench, shared contracts, Python validators, and native macOS scaffolds.

scripts.format:check: pnpm exec biome check --formatter-enabled=true --linter-enabled=false --assist-enabled=false . && ./.venv/bin/python3 -m ruff format --check python tools/analysis tools/security tools/contracts scripts/local scripts/test scripts/tasks scripts/agent
